role: Declares RecordPanels, a non-View @MainActor struct that holds the record tab's observable state, derived flags, action closures and bindings so the large panel builders (in RecordView+Panels.swift) can live outside RecordView.
types: RecordPanels: struct (@MainActor, not a View) — collector, DeviceStatus, MorningCoordination, StreamingLifecycle, SessionState, SettingsManager, isActivelyRecording/isBatteryLow/isBatteryCritical, 8 action closures, 4 bindings, BreathingAudioManager
